text: The purpose of this report is to recommend the appointment of a Member of Council to the Seniors Housing Corporation Board of Directors.

City Council on May 5 and 6, 2021, adopted the following: 1. City Council appoint Councillor Paula Fletcher to the Seniors Housing Corporation Board of Directors for a term of office until November 14, 2022 and until a successor is appointed. Mayor Tory has appointed Councillor Paul Ainslie as the Mayor's designate.
